gcd(81,27) binary algorithm: gcd(81,27). Binary algorithm: shift out common factors of 2. 81 odd, 27 odd. Then while a != b: subtract smaller from larger: 81-27=54. Now a=54, b=27. 54 even, shift right: 54/2=27. Now a=27,b=27. So gcd=27. So gcd=27.

lcm(15,25) standard: lcm = a*b/gcd(a,b). gcd(15,25)=5. So lcm=15*25/5=75.

lcm(21,14) reduced algorithm: lcm = a*b/gcd(a,b). gcd(21,14)=7. So lcm=21*14/7=42.
